blocks.text: Julia Garner was personally selected by Madonna to play her in a biopic, which has been in the works for several years.
In a new interview, the Weapons star was asked if the film or series was still moving forward.
“I don’t know,” Garner told CBS Sunday Morning , adding, “Every hour it changes, in a way.”

The Madonna biopic was first announced in 2020. In January 2023, it was reported that Universal Pictures had scrapped the film . Madonna was set to direct the film about her life and career, penning the script with Diablo Cody and Erin Cressida Wilson.

blocks.text: After the film was put on hold, Madonna teased in July 2024 that she was back working on a script for her biopic. In 2025 , Deadline exclusively reported that Madonna had partnered with Netflix to tell her story in a TV series being developed alongside Shawn Lev y.

“It’s not up to me,” Garner told the weekend morning show. “I would love for the movie to get made, obviously. But I also feel whatever happens, like, I made a great friend. I love Madonna. I think she’s incredible.”
Garner was featured in Madonna’s Confessions II — The Film and also joined her on stage at the 2026 VMAs.
Of working with Madonna, Garner said, “She works. She taught me properly how to work. That’s what I mean by work.”
In September 2025 , Garner shared with W Magazine that the Madonna biopic was still “a work in progress.”
